name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a full QPE program in Qiskit (6 ancilla
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a full QPE program in Qiskit (6 ancilla qubits, target unitary P(2*pi*0.203125)) including the inverse QFT, and report the most likely phase estimate. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
